questionText: How would you design an idempotent payment API endpoint?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can design one durable payment attempt across client and provider failure boundaries without claiming exactly-once execution.

claims.statement: Because POST has no general idempotency guarantee, retry behavior for a payment creation operation must be defined by that API's contract.

examples.title: Create payment request and stable payment resource response

validation.expected: A retry uses the same key and operation-defining request to recover the same payment resource

visuals.title: Client, payment API, durable store, and provider retry path

notes: Provider idempotency behavior is intentionally described as conditional on provider support, not as a universal protocol fact.
The provider-reference and reconciliation guidance remains editorially pending rather than being attributed to RFC 9110.

review.notes: The HTTP boundary was checked against RFC 9110. Payment workflow guidance, rendered Mermaid, and final editorial review remain intentionally non-approved.
